evidence.summary: Varying linked_accounts across 7.8, 15.6, and 20.0 holding all other parameters fixed produced an identical output score of 0.9900, confirming zero feature impact.
Increasing months_active from 0.0 to 6.4 and 32.2 steadily decreases the moderation score from 0.9900 down to 0.9640 (~ -0.0008 per active month).
Reducing post_length from 100 to 17.5 causes a steep score decline from 0.9900 to 0.9275, demonstrating a strong positive scaling effect.
Increasing reputation above 300 causes an immediate penalty to approval score (e.g. 350 yields 0.9858 vs 0.9900 at 300), confirming inverse logic.
